clips.title: The story
paras: Ozzie Togglevolt seeks a sample from Gnomeregan’s troggs in a heavy, lead-lined phial. He hopes to make a cure for irradiated leper gnomes, or perhaps a dangerously potent rum.

The phial’s lead lining shields its carrier from the volatile green fallout that saturates Gnomeregan. High Tinker Mekkatorque’s advisors flooded the lower corridors with toxic radiation to stop the invading troggs. Instead, the disaster corrupted troggs and surviving gnomes into maddened, irradiated horrors. Fluid residue gathered from Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers gives refugee tinkerers in Kharanos, including Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket, raw material for their experiments on remedies.
